wins: Reached final environment state with maximal reward 60, showing ability to navigate full episode.
Executed repeatable reconnaissance chain (nmap, dirsearch) that consistently surfaced host fingerprinting data.
Captured multiple telemetry points enabling follow-up persistence playbooks.
fails: No recorded successful credential access or lateral movement despite full episode, leaving success rate at 0%.
Mentor calls did not translate into execution improvements; repeated attempts still stalled before weaponization.
key_outcomes.summary: Reconnaissance phase solid, but exploitation/credential pivot never materialized, keeping overall success at zero despite high reward.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Unable to successfully escalate privileges after initial reconnaissance, getting blocked at credential brute-force step.

skill_cards.if_condition: When SSH port 22 is open and banner reveals outdated OpenSSH version
skill_cards.then_action: Run targeted nmap script scan against ssh-auth-methods and sshv1

skill_cards.if_condition: When web server on port 80/443 returns consistent 200 OK with a robots.txt
skill_cards.then_action: Follow with dirsearch recursive scan focusing on disallowed paths

skill_cards.if_condition: When initial port scan reveals SMB 445 open without enforcement
skill_cards.then_action: Attempt smbclient anonymous list to enumerate shares before brute forcing

memory_ops.reason: High success rate in SSH footprinting leading to actionable profile data
Dirsearch results consistently provided new endpoints for follow-up testing
